evidence.description: treesAt(_:) obtains live tree statistics directly from Statistics.shared rather than an injected dependency.

candidates.explanation: TreesProjection directly accesses the external Statistics service through its singleton to obtain operational statistics. No explicit, replaceable dependency boundary supplies this service.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: TreesProjection stores the task in its timerTask property.
Although the capture starts weak, guard let self creates a strong reference before the repeating loop and retains it across all iterations and suspensions.
The only visible cancellation occurs in deinit, which cannot break the task's retention of its owner before deallocation.

candidates.explanation: The stored repeating task promotes its weak owner reference to a strong local reference before entering the loop. That reference remains alive for the task's lifetime, creating an owner–task retention cycle. The loop has no independently guaranteed termination, and cancellation in deinit cannot resolve a cycle that prevents deinitialization.
candidates.title: Task Ownership Retain Cycle
